1 Bar-cum-Restaurant.

Pursuant to his application, a false Inquiry Report vide letter No.1 dated 17.01.2023 was submitted by Inspector of Excise, Jajpur Range, Jajpur namely, Swapnarani Sahoo who conducted field Inquiry to ascertain the actual position of the proposed shop i.e. Rout and Rout Restaurant and the feasibility and eligibility to get the On-Shop License as per Excise Rules.

As per Excise Rules, there should not be any Bathing Ghat, Educational and Religious Institutions, Railway Station, Mills/ Factories, Petrol Pump, habitants of SC/ST Community, any irrigations and development Project, Bank, Medical etc. within the radious of 500 Meters from the proposed shop.

Furthermore, the proposed Restaurant must have been truly in running/ functioning condition for at least last two years and having GST Registration Number for the purpose of eligibility to apply for the On-Shop/ Bar.
The Restaurant must have Food Safety License for the last two years.

The Excise Inspector namely, Swapanarani Sahoo, the R.I. namely, Manoj Kumar Kabi being sufficiently bribed from Madhusudan Rout to give false Report violating and suppressing the actual, // 3 // relevant fact of the spot and practical position of the said Restaurant, so as to facilitate the said Restaurant owner to get the On-shop Bar License in respect of the said Restaurant.

In fact, practically there was no such Restaurant is functioning for last two years as required under the Excise Rules, the Food Safety Inspector, Rakesh Sahoo has also given false Food Safety License without verifying the spot.
Further case of the petitioner is that there was a peanuts Mill and SBI Mini Bank functioning adjacent to the proposed On- Shop / Restaurant.
Practically, no such Restaurant was functioning at least for the last 2 years in the name and style as "Rout and Rout Restaurant".

It is further submitted that one educational Institution namely, "Chidananda Yoga Sankruti Sansthan" to conduct M.A. in Yoga Course under the affiliation of the Utkal University of Culture, wherein more than 70 students are pursuing their M.A. Course regularly and is situated within 20 Meters from the proposed Shop since the year 2020.
Similarly, the proposed shop is within the village Garuala having number of SC and ST inhabitants along with thousands of villagers residing therein .

Further, Bathing Ghat,
Madhuban High Schools, Jaganath Temple and Temple of village goddess are situated within 300-400 Meters from the proposed shop.

However, the aforesaid three public officials being connived with the so called Restaurant i.e. Madhusudan Rout adopted corrupt // 4 // practice and they have given false report vide letter No.01 dated 17.01.2023 suppressing the aforesaid relevant and true facts flouting the Law / Rules, so as to enable the said Madhusudan Rout to get the On-Shop License on the proposed site, even though he is not eligible to get the On- Shop License on the proposed shop.
Furthermore, granting of License on the said spot would be illegal and would spoil the career and life of children, youth and adjacent innocent villagers.

5. The Petitioner lodged a written Compliant dated 27.02.2023 before the Opposite Party No.3/
Deputy Superintendent of Police (Vigilance), Jajpur Vigilance Unit, Jajpur, under Cuttack division for conducting an Inquiry and to take legal action against the aforesaid corrupt public servants for the aforesaid illegalities.
However, no action has yet been taken on the same.

6. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner has sent a copy of the said written Report to the Opposite Party No.2/ the Superintendent of Police(Vigilance), Cuttack on 27.02.2023 by Registered Post for Inquiry and Legal action.

He further submits that the Director, Chidananda Yoga Sankruti Sansthan, has also submitted his complaint along with all the required documents to the Opposite Party No.4, Collector, Jajpur vide his Letter No.153 dated 26.12.2022 highlighting the aforesaid // 5 // illegalities.

7. Learned counsel for the Petitioner further submits that the Annexure-1 reveals a cognizable offence under Section 7 of the P.C.Act and offences for abuse of official position and showing undue official favour by taking bribe money, and other offences under Sections 420/ 120B of the I.P.C.
committed by the aforesaid public servants, which requires an impartial and immediate inquiry followed by registration of the FIR in order to initiate action against the said corrupt public servants by the Vigilance Department.

However, no action has yet been taken by the Opposite Parties Nos.2 and 3 to cause an Inquiry and to register the case for the aforementioned illegalities/ irregularities and to take appropriate legal action against the said culprits.

It is also submitted that the aforesaid action on the part of the Opposite Parties by not conducting Inquiry as required under the Law and non-registration of FIR is illegal and violative of the directions of the Hon'ble Apex Court passed in the case of LalitaKumari vs. State of UP1, and State of Telengana vs. Sri Mamago[et @ MangipetSarveshwarReddy2.

The written report of the present Petitioner demands an independent, impartial and immediate Inquiry as well as investigation and appropriate action against the aforesaid public servants as well as the said Restaurant owner by the Opposite Party Nos.2 and 3.
9.

In view of the above facts and circumstances, the Petitioner seeks to invoke the extra-ordinary jurisdiction of this Court challenging the action of the part of the Opposite Parties who have neither conducted any inquiry on the written report dated 27.02.2023 (Annexure-1), against the present Petitioner nor they have carried out any investigation or any legal action against the culprits.

Hence,
in the interest of Justice, a direction may be given to the Opposite Party No.2 to cause an Inquiry into the matter and AIR 2014 SC 187 2 Criminal Appeal No.1663 of 2019 (arising out of SLP (Criminal) No.4074 of 2019) (decided on 6th December, 2019) // 7 // registered the complaint under Annexture-1 as F.I.R. and to take legal action against the corrupt officials named therein along with the other culprits.
